page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no marginal notes. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: fum, sed non integrum, cui statim subjunctus est versus nonus ejusdem primi capitis, cum quo finiunt pagina & specimen.

Quæ amanuensis incuria male scripta sunt, nihil attinet castigare; hæc tantum illustrem Dominationem tuam monebo: comparavi Pentateuchi tui Samaritani specimen cum eodem loco Pentateuchi nostri Samaritano-Hebraei; tuus versio est Samaritana, verbum verbo ad amussim respondens, nostro Samaritano-Hebraeo versio exactior & rigidior fingi non potest. Interpres ille longe pertinacius ipso Onkelo, Paraphraste Chaldaeo, textui Hebraeo adhaeret; exactam istam translationem, ex alio brevissimo specimine, quod ad me antea nomine tuo missum fuerat, jam conjeceram, conjectura ista ex præsenti periclitatione confirmata est.
Cum Samaritanum tuū [?] cum Hebraeo tam Samaritanorum, quam Judeorum conferrem, deprehendi in paucis versibus ad me missis, utrumque Samaritanum in nonnullis cum 70. interp. editionis Romanæ con-

page.notes: Show-through and scan edge on the right side of the image (grey vertical bands) are not printed text and are omitted. Word "tuū" in the third paragraph is doubtful: the scan shows a mark over the u, read as an abbreviation sign, [?] applied. Page number "181" is partly obscured at the top right and is uncertain. Signature "I 7" at the foot is uncertain, the first mark may be a figure or letter. Printed "tuus versio" and "Qvæ" are copied as printed apart from u/v normalisation; "tuus versio" is probably a printer's error for "tua versio" and is left unchanged. Catchword "sen-" is read from the foot right.
